name: team_planning_set_unit
description: Create, rename or move a unit in a scenario of a Team Planning plan. Without unit_id it creates a unit, which needs a name and a level_id from the Org Graph taxonomy. With unit_id (an Org Graph unit, or one the plan created) it changes that unit: whatever you leave out stays as the scenario has it, and a retired unit comes back. parent_id places it beneath a live unit at a higher level; top_level true puts it at the top. A unit's level can't change. scenario_id defaults to the baseline, whose id is the plan's. Refused unless the caller is one of the plan's editors. `note` is Markdown: links, **bold**, _italic_, lists and `code` render, a bare URL becomes a link, typed HTML shows as text and images render as links.

note.description: Why this is in the plan, such as why this person moves. Optional, at most 2000 characters; it never changes what the scenario resolves to. Deleting the plan erases it.

name.description: What the unit is, such as 'Payments'. Don't put a person's name in it.
